description: Run inference with a trained model on an image URL or base64 image (`source`), or on a local image or video file (`file_path`). Give exactly one.

conf.description: Confidence threshold (0.01-1, server default applies if omitted).

file_path.description: Local path to an image or video file, uploaded as-is. The server decides which formats and sizes it accepts.

imgsz.description: Inference image size (32-1280, server default applies if omitted).

iou.description: IoU threshold used for NMS (0-0.95, server default applies if omitted).

model.description: Model ref by owner/project/model, ul:// URI, or slug (requires project).

project.description: Project ref required when model is given by slug.

source.description: Image URL, base64-encoded image (standard or URL-safe; optional padding; ASCII whitespace ignored), or base64 data: URI (data:<mime>;base64,<payload>). Base64 is uploaded as an image file, bypassing the API source field's 4,096-character limit; MCP client argument limits may still apply, so prefer file_path for local files.

name: model_predict
